summary.plain: A storage chamber for ultracold neutrons in a very uniform magnetic field with electrodes, plus mercury and caesium magnetometers that track field changes while the neutrons’ spins precess.
summary.technical: UCN precession chamber with electric-field reversal, 199Hg co-magnetometer and caesium-vapour magnetometer array; apparatus originally built by the RAL/Sussex/ILL collaboration and upgraded and moved to PSI.

technology.quote: The salient features of this experiment were the use of a Hg-199 co-magnetometer and an array of optically pumped cesium vapor magnetometers to cancel and correct for magnetic field changes.
technology.value: Single-chamber Ramsey spectrometer with a Hg-199 co-magnetometer and an array of optically pumped caesium magnetometers
